policy: Require known native kin for sibling or living-parent references. Observing other families and aspiring to future parenthood remain allowed. Past apprentice-mentoring attachments and active teaching responsibility require an appropriate adult age; no skills or roles are granted. Unknown family evidence selects another concept. Optional maximum ages keep young-child care needs from infantilizing older children.
